titel: Puff pastry tart with red pesto, roasted vegetables and feta
stappen: Toss the vegetables with the oil and pepper. Roast them on a baking tray for 10 min.
Unroll the puff pastry onto baking paper and prick it all over with a fork. Leave a 2 cm border.
Spread the pesto over the pastry, inside the border.
Spread the vegetables over the pesto and crumble the feta on top.
Bake for 20–25 min until the edge is golden brown. Garnish with rocket and pine nuts.
tips: Roast the vegetables first, so the base does not go soggy.
